token_near_graduation.meaning: LaunchToken is near its graduation (approaching BONDING_SUPPLY)

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token, quote) UniSwapV2 pair exists, deployed before graduation

graduation_completed.meaning: the graduation transaction completes without reverting (addLiquidity succeeds)

graduation_reverted.meaning: the addLiquidity call fails and the whole graduation transaction reverts

assumptions: The pair is deployed before graduation and exists at graduation time.
Graduation is triggered when the token reaches BONDING_SUPPLY on a buy.
The graduation path calls uniV2Router.addLiquidity to deposit 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of 'near graduation' (approaching BONDING_SUPPLY); represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence condition.
Whether reserveA or reserveB is the 1-wei side depends on token ordering, which the report leaves conditional; the revert mechanism is not fully determined.

limitations: Formalizes only the graduation_reverts impact; permanent DoS and forced user withdrawal are separate impacts not covered here.
The 1-wei deposit and sync are described as a possible attack, not an observed transaction.
Permissionlessness of pair deployment and direct deposit is not explicitly asserted.
